descFull: Radzen Blazor is the most sophisticated free UI component library for Blazor: 155+ native components including DataGrid, Scheduler, Gantt and 30+ chart types, with advanced theming for Material Design and Fluent UI. MIT, free for commercial use. If Radzen Blazor is useful to you, a ⭐ on GitHub helps other Blazor developers find it.
